Watch this classic song 'Pyasi Hai Mamta Meri Aaja Re' sung by Usha Mangeshkar from 1962 Movie Maa Beta starring Manoj Kumar, Ameeta and Nirupa Roy in the lead. Maa Beta is Directed by Lekhraj Bhakri while the Music is composed by Hemant Kumar and Lyrics are penned by Prem Dhawan.
Movie: Maa Beta (1962)
Singer: Usha Mangeshkar
Music: Hemant Kumar
Lyrics: Prem Dhawan
Cast: Nirupa Roy
Director: Lekhraj Bhakri
